# nah_policy (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_policy" "read_network" {
  id = "POLICY_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) Evaluation actions.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `effect` (String) Evaluation effect.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `org_id` (String) Opaque organization ID.
